while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Largest Only a MAXLOC\n//             all-reduce plus the broadcast of the winning cluster is needed\n//             per outer iteration.\n//   * CUDA  - growing the candidate cluster of a seed is executed by one CUDA\n//             block per seed, so thousands of seeds are grown concurrently.\n//   * OpenMP- host side bookkeeping (cache invalidation, membership,\n//             validation) and the growth of small seed batches, where a GPU\n//             launch cannot be filled, run on the multi-core host.\n//\n// Algorithmic notes (semantics preserving):\n//   * The maximum distance of a candidate to the members of the growing\n//     cluster is maintained incrementally instead of being recomputed from\n//     scratch (max over the same set of values, hence identical).\n//   * All distance work is carried out on *squared* distances.  sqrt() is\n//     monotone, so the arg-min is unchanged; the threshold predicate\n//     sqrt(d2) < threshold is turned into d2 <= t2max where t2max is the\n//     largest double whose square root is still below the threshold, which\n//     makes the predicate bit-exactly equivalent.\n//   * The candidate cluster of a seed is cached and only recomputed when the\n//     cluster that was just committed intersects it.  Removing points that\n//     were never selected cannot change any arg-min decision, so the cached\n//     result stays exact.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Largest double t2 for which (sqrt(d2) < threshold) <=> (d2 <= t2).\n// sqrt() is correctly rounded and therefore monotone, so such a value exists.\nstatic double squaredThreshold(const double threshold) {\n    double t2 = threshold * threshold;\n    while (t2 > 0.0 && std::sqrt(t2) >= threshold) {\n        t2 = std::nextafter(t2, 0.0);\n    }\n    while (std::sqrt(std::nextafter(t2, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity())) < threshold) {\n        t2 = std::nextafter(t2, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());\n    }\n    return t2;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Ordering used by the arg-min reduction: smallest value wins, ties are broken\n// towards the smaller point index (identical to the sequential scan order).\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool qtBetter(double av, int ai, double bv, int bi) {\n    if (ai < 0) return false;\n    if (bi < 0) return true;\n    return (av < bv) || (av == bv && ai < bi);\n}\n\n// One block grows the candidate cluster of one seed.\n// dwork holds a row of N running squared maximum distances per block; a value\n// of HUGE_VAL marks a point that is a member of the growing cluster or that was\n// already clustered globally.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QTC_MAX_BLOCK)\nvoid qtGrowKernel(const double* __restrict__ px,\n                  const double* __restrict__ py,\n                  const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                  const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                  const int numSeeds, const int N, const double t2max,\n                  double* __restrict__ dwork, int* __restrict__ card) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n    double* __restrict__ d = dwork + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n\n    for (int i = tid; i < N; i += nt) {\n        d[i] = clustered[i] ? HUGE_VAL : 0.0;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sv[QTC_MAX_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int si[QTC_MAX_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int s_next;\n\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const int nwarps = nt >> 5;\n\n    int cnt = 0;\n    int cur = seeds[b];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    while (true) {\n        if (tid == 0) d[cur] = HUGE_VAL;\n        ++cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (cnt >= N) break;\n\n        const double mx = px[cur];\n        const double my = py[cur];\n\n        double bv = HUGE_VAL;\n        int bi = -1;\n        for (int i = tid; i < N; i += nt) {\n            double v = d[i];\n            if (v <= t2max) {\n                const double dx = px[i] - mx;\n                const double dy = py[i] - my;\n                const double s = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n                if (s > v) { v = s; d[i] = v; }\n                if (v <= t2max && qtBetter(v, i, bv, bi)) { bv = v; bi = i; }\n            }\n        }\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bv, off);\n            const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bi, off);\n            if (qtBetter(ov, oi, bv, bi)) { bv = ov; bi = oi; }\n        }\n        if (lane == 0) { sv[warp] = bv; si[warp] = bi; }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (warp == 0) {\n            bv = (lane < nwarps) ? sv[lane] : HUGE_VAL;\n            bi = (lane < nwarps) ? si[lane] : -1;\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bv, off);\n                const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bi, off);\n                if (qtBetter(ov, oi, bv, bi)) { bv = ov; bi = oi; }\n            }\n            if (lane == 0) s_next = bi;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        if (s_next < 0) break;\n        cur = s_next;\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) card[b] = cnt;\n}\n\n// Compact the member lists (points marked HUGE_VAL that are not globally\n// clustered) of every block into one contiguous output buffer.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QTC_MAX_BLOCK)\nvoid qtCollectKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                     const double* __restrict__ dwork,\n                     const int numSeeds, const int N,\n                     const int* __restrict__ offsets,\n                     int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    __shared__ int pos;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) pos = offsets[b];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const double* __restrict__ d = dwork + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n        if (d[i] == HUGE_VAL && !clustered[i]) {\n            out[atomicAdd(&pos, 1)] = i;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side cluster growth (used for batches too small to fill the GPU)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic void growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                            const double* __restrict__ px,\n                            const double* __restrict__ py,\n                            const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                            const int N, const double t2max,\n                            double* __restrict__ d,\n                            std::vector<int>& members) {\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) d[i] = clustered[i] ? HUGE_VAL : 0.0;\n    members.clear();\n\n    int cur = seed;\n    while (true) {\n        d[cur] = HUGE_VAL;\n        members.push_back(cur);\n        if (static_cast<int>(members.size()) >= N) break;\n\n        const double mx = px[cur];\n        const double my = py[cur];\n        double bv = HUGE_VAL;\n        int bi = -1;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            double v = d[i];\n            if (v <= t2max) {\n                const double dx = px[i] - mx;\n                const double dy = py[i] - my;\n                const double s = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n                if (s > v) { v = s; d[i] = v; }\n                if (v <= t2max && (bi < 0 || v < bv)) { bv = v; bi = i; }\n            }\n        }\n        if (bi < 0) break;\n        cur = bi;\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GPU resource management\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuContext {\n    double* px = nullptr;\n    double* py = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* clustered = nullptr;\n    int* seeds = nullptr;\n    double* dwork = nullptr;\n    int* card = nullptr;\n    int* offsets = nullptr;\n    int* members = nullptr;\n    size_t membersCap = 0;\n\n    int* h_card = nullptr;\n    int* h_offsets = nullptr;\n    int* h_members = nullptr;\n    size_t h_membersCap = 0;\n\n    int maxBlocks = 0;\n    int blockSize = QTC_MAX_BLOCK;\n};\n\nstatic void gpuInit(GpuContext& g, const std::vector<double>& hx,\n                    const std::vector<double>& hy, const int N) {\n    size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n\n    // The growth kernel needs N doubles of scratch per concurrently grown seed.\n    size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(freeMem * 0.5);\n    size_t perBlock = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double);\n    int maxBlocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(budget / perBlock, QTC_MAX_BLOCKS));\n    if (maxBlocks < 1) maxBlocks = 1;\n    if (maxBlocks > N) maxBlocks = N;\n    g.maxBlocks = maxBlocks;\n\n    int blk = QTC_MAX_BLOCK;\n    while (blk > 32 && blk >= 4 * N) blk >>= 1;\n    g.blockSize = blk;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.px, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.py, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.clustered, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.seeds, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.dwork, static_cast<size_t>(maxBlocks) * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.card, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.offsets, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.px, hx.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.py, hy.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(g.clustered, 0, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_card, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_offsets, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n}\n\nstatic void gpuFree(GpuContext& g) {\n    cudaFree(g.px);\n    cudaFree(g.py);\n    cudaFree(g.clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.dwork);\n    cudaFree(g.card);\n    cudaFree(g.offsets);\n    cudaFree(g.members);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_card);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_offsets);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_members);\n}\n\nstatic void ensureMemberCapacity(GpuContext& g, const size_t need) {\n    if (need <= g.membersCap) return;\n    size_t cap = std::max<size_t>(need, g.membersCap * 2);\n    cudaFree(g.members);\n    g.members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.members, cap * sizeof(int)));\n    g.membersCap = cap;\n\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_members);\n    g.h_members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_members, cap * sizeof(int)));\n    g.h_membersCap = cap;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank, const int nranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double t2max = squaredThreshold(threshold);\n\n    std::vector<double> hx(N), hy(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) { hx[i] = points[i].x; hy[i] = points[i].y; }\n\n    GpuContext gpu;\n    gpuInit(gpu, hx, hy, N);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> removed(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> dirty(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> card(N, 0);\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cache(N);\n\n    // Cyclic ownership of the seeds keeps the (spatially clustered) recompute\n    // sets evenly spread over the ranks.\n    std::vector<int> owned;\n    owned.reserve(N / nranks + 1);\n    for (int i = rank; i < N; i += nranks) {\n        owned.push_back(i);\n        dirty[i] = 1;\n    }\n\n    // Per-thread scratch for the host growth path\n    const int nthreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<std::vector<double>> scratch(nthreads);\n\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    std::vector<int> todo;\n    bool devMaskValid = true;  // device copy of `clustered` up to date\n    int remaining = N;\n\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // ---- 1. (Re)compute the candidate clusters of the dirty owned seeds\n        todo.clear();\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < owned.size(); ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (dirty[s]) todo.push_back(s);\n        }\n\n        const int T = static_cast<int>(todo.size());\n        if (T >= QTC_GPU_MIN_SEEDS) {\n            if (!devMaskValid) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                      N * sizeof(unsigned char), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                devMaskValid = true;\n            }\n            for (int s0 = 0; s0 < T; s0 += gpu.maxBlocks) {\n                const int B = std::min(gpu.maxBlocks, T - s0);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.seeds, todo.data() + s0, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                qtGrowKernel<<<B, gpu.blockSize>>>(gpu.px, gpu.py, gpu.clustered, gpu.seeds,\n                                                   B, N, t2max, gpu.dwork, gpu.card);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.h_card, gpu.card, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n                size_t total = 0;\n                for (int b = 0; b < B; ++b) {\n                    gpu.h_offsets[b] = static_cast<int>(total);\n                    total += static_cast<size_t>(gpu.h_card[b]);\n                }\n                ensureMemberCapacity(gpu, total);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.offsets, gpu.h_offsets, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                qtCollectKernel<<<B, gpu.blockSize>>>(gpu.clustered, gpu.dwork, B, N,\n                                                      gpu.offsets, gpu.members);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.h_members, gpu.members, total * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n                #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n                for (int b = 0; b < B; ++b) {\n                    const int s = todo[s0 + b];\n                    const int c = gpu.h_card[b];\n                    card[s] = c;\n                    cache[s].assign(gpu.h_members + gpu.h_offsets[b],\n                                    gpu.h_members + gpu.h_offsets[b] + c);\n                    dirty[s] = 0;\n                }\n            }\n        } else if (T > 0) {\n            #pragma omp parallel\n            {\n                const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n                std::vector<double>& d = scratch[tid];\n                if (static_cast<int>(d.size()) != N) d.resize(N);\n                #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n                for (int j = 0; j < T; ++j) {\n                    const int s = todo[j];\n                    growClusterHost(s, hx.data(), hy.data(), clustered.data(), N, t2max,\n                                    d.data(), cache[s]);\n                    card[s] = static_cast<int>(cache[s].size());\n                    dirty[s] = 0;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // ---- 2. Globally pick the seed with the largest cardinality\n        int local[2] = {-1, N};\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < owned.size(); ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (card[s] > local[0]) { local[0] = card[s]; local[1] = s; }\n        }\n        int best[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(local, best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_card = best[0];\n        const int best_seed = best[1];\n        if (best_seed >= N || best_card <= 0) break;\n\n        // ---- 3. Broadcast the winning cluster and commit it\n        std::vector<int> mem;\n        const int root = best_seed % nranks;\n        if (rank == root) {\n            mem = cache[best_seed];\n        } else {\n            mem.resize(best_card);\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(mem.data(), best_card, MPI_INT, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (int j = 0; j < best_card; ++j) {\n            clustered[mem[j]] = 1;\n            removed[mem[j]] = 1;\n        }\n        remaining -= best_card;\n        devMaskValid = false;\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            Cluster c;\n            c.seed_point = best_seed;\n            c.members = mem;\n            clusters.push_back(std::move(c));\n        }\n\n        // ---- 4. Invalidate the cached candidate clusters that intersect the\n        //         cluster we just removed; everything else stays exact.\n        const int M = static_cast<int>(owned.size());\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (clustered[s]) { cache[s].clear(); cache[s].shrink_to_fit(); card[s] = -1; continue; }\n            if (dirty[s]) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& cm = cache[s];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < cm.size(); ++k) {\n                if (removed[cm[k]]) { dirty[s] = 1; card[s] = -1; break; }\n            }\n        }\n        for (int j = 0; j < best_card; ++j) removed[mem[j]] = 0;\n\n        owned.erase(std::remove_if(owned.begin(), owned.end(),\n                                   [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                    owned.end());\n    }\n\n    gpuFree(gpu);\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int C = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(C, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        const std::vector<int>& members = clusters[c].members;\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[members[i]], points[members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = c;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    // Bind one GPU per rank and share the cores of a node between the ranks\n    MPI_Comm local_comm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_comm);\n    int local_rank = 0, local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(local_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(local_comm, &local_size);\n\n    int devCount = 0;\n    if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount) != cudaSuccess || devCount == 0) {\n        if (rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"Error: no CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(local_rank % devCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));  // establish the context up front\n\n    if (omp_get_max_threads() > 1) {\n        const int cores = omp_get_num_procs();\n        int t = cores / local_size;\n        if (t < 1) t = 1;\n        omp_set_num_threads(t);\n    }\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, replicated on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, nranks);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    int exit_code = 0;\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n        // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n        int total_clustered = 0;\n        int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n            const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n            total_clustered += size;\n            max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n        }\n\n        const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n            static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n            std::vector<double> membershipData;\n            membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n            std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n                for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n                    membership[clusters[c].members[i]] = static_cast<int>(c);\n                }\n            }\n            for (int m : membership) {\n                membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n            }\n            print_results(membershipData, (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Largest double t2 for which (sqrt(d2) < threshold) <=> (d2 <= t2).\n// sqrt() is correctly rounded and therefore monotone, so such a value exists.\nstatic double squaredThreshold(const double threshold) {\n    double t2 = threshold * threshold;\n    while (t2 > 0.0 && std::sqrt(t2) >= threshold) {\n        t2 = std::nextafter(t2, 0.0);\n    }\n    while (std::sqrt(std::nextafter(t2, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity())) < threshold) {\n        t2 = std::nextafter(t2, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity());\n    }\n    return t2;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Ordering used by the arg-min reduction: smallest value wins, ties are broken\n// towards the smaller point index (identical to the sequential scan order).\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool qtBetter(double av, int ai, double bv, int bi) {\n    if (ai < 0) return false;\n    if (bi < 0) return true;\n    return (av < bv) || (av == bv && ai < bi);\n}\n\n// One block grows the candidate cluster of one seed.\n// dwork holds a row of N running squared maximum distances per block; a value\n// of HUGE_VAL marks a point that is a member of the growing cluster or that was\n// already clustered globally.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QTC_MAX_BLOCK)\nvoid qtGrowKernel(const double* __restrict__ px,\n                  const double* __restrict__ py,\n                  const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                  const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                  const int numSeeds, const int N, const double t2max,\n                  double* __restrict__ dwork, int* __restrict__ card) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n    double* __restrict__ d = dwork + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n\n    for (int i = tid; i < N; i += nt) {\n        d[i] = clustered[i] ? HUGE_VAL : 0.0;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double sv[QTC_MAX_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int si[QTC_MAX_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int s_next;\n\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const int nwarps = nt >> 5;\n\n    int cnt = 0;\n    int cur = seeds[b];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    while (true) {\n        if (tid == 0) d[cur] = HUGE_VAL;\n        ++cnt;\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (cnt >= N) break;\n\n        const double mx = px[cur];\n        const double my = py[cur];\n\n        double bv = HUGE_VAL;\n        int bi = -1;\n        for (int i = tid; i < N; i += nt) {\n            double v = d[i];\n            if (v <= t2max) {\n                const double dx = px[i] - mx;\n                const double dy = py[i] - my;\n                const double s = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n                if (s > v) { v = s; d[i] = v; }\n                if (v <= t2max && qtBetter(v, i, bv, bi)) { bv = v; bi = i; }\n            }\n        }\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bv, off);\n            const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bi, off);\n            if (qtBetter(ov, oi, bv, bi)) { bv = ov; bi = oi; }\n        }\n        if (lane == 0) { sv[warp] = bv; si[warp] = bi; }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (warp == 0) {\n            bv = (lane < nwarps) ? sv[lane] : HUGE_VAL;\n            bi = (lane < nwarps) ? si[lane] : -1;\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bv, off);\n                const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bi, off);\n                if (qtBetter(ov, oi, bv, bi)) { bv = ov; bi = oi; }\n            }\n            if (lane == 0) s_next = bi;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        if (s_next < 0) break;\n        cur = s_next;\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) card[b] = cnt;\n}\n\n// Compact the member lists (points marked HUGE_VAL that are not globally\n// clustered) of every block into one contiguous output buffer.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QTC_MAX_BLOCK)\nvoid qtCollectKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                     const double* __restrict__ dwork,\n                     const int numSeeds, const int N,\n                     const int* __restrict__ offsets,\n                     int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    __shared__ int pos;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) pos = offsets[b];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const double* __restrict__ d = dwork + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n        if (d[i] == HUGE_VAL && !clustered[i]) {\n            out[atomicAdd(&pos, 1)] = i;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side cluster growth (used for batches too small to fill the GPU)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic void growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                            const double* __restrict__ px,\n                            const double* __restrict__ py,\n                            const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                            const int N, const double t2max,\n                            double* __restrict__ d,\n                            std::vector<int>& members) {\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) d[i] = clustered[i] ? HUGE_VAL : 0.0;\n    members.clear();\n\n    int cur = seed;\n    while (true) {\n        d[cur] = HUGE_VAL;\n        members.push_back(cur);\n        if (static_cast<int>(members.size()) >= N) break;\n\n        const double mx = px[cur];\n        const double my = py[cur];\n        double bv = HUGE_VAL;\n        int bi = -1;\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            double v = d[i];\n            if (v <= t2max) {\n                const double dx = px[i] - mx;\n                const double dy = py[i] - my;\n                const double s = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n                if (s > v) { v = s; d[i] = v; }\n                if (v <= t2max && (bi < 0 || v < bv)) { bv = v; bi = i; }\n            }\n        }\n        if (bi < 0) break;\n        cur = bi;\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GPU resource management\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuContext {\n    double* px = nullptr;\n    double* py = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* clustered = nullptr;\n    int* seeds = nullptr;\n    double* dwork = nullptr;\n    int* card = nullptr;\n    int* offsets = nullptr;\n    int* members = nullptr;\n    size_t membersCap = 0;\n\n    int* h_card = nullptr;\n    int* h_offsets = nullptr;\n    int* h_members = nullptr;\n    size_t h_membersCap = 0;\n\n    int maxBlocks = 0;\n    int blockSize = QTC_MAX_BLOCK;\n};\n\nstatic void gpuInit(GpuContext& g, const std::vector<double>& hx,\n                    const std::vector<double>& hy, const int N) {\n    size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n\n    // The growth kernel needs N doubles of scratch per concurrently grown seed.\n    size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(freeMem * 0.5);\n    size_t perBlock = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double);\n    int maxBlocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(budget / perBlock, QTC_MAX_BLOCKS));\n    if (maxBlocks < 1) maxBlocks = 1;\n    if (maxBlocks > N) maxBlocks = N;\n    g.maxBlocks = maxBlocks;\n\n    int blk = QTC_MAX_BLOCK;\n    while (blk > 32 && blk >= 4 * N) blk >>= 1;\n    g.blockSize = blk;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.px, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.py, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.clustered, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.seeds, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.dwork, static_cast<size_t>(maxBlocks) * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.card, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.offsets, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.px, hx.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.py, hy.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(g.clustered, 0, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_card, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_offsets, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n}\n\nstatic void gpuFree(GpuContext& g) {\n    cudaFree(g.px);\n    cudaFree(g.py);\n    cudaFree(g.clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.dwork);\n    cudaFree(g.card);\n    cudaFree(g.offsets);\n    cudaFree(g.members);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_card);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_offsets);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_members);\n}\n\nstatic void ensureMemberCapacity(GpuContext& g, const size_t need) {\n    if (need <= g.membersCap) return;\n    size_t cap = std::max<size_t>(need, g.membersCap * 2);\n    cudaFree(g.members);\n    g.members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.members, cap * sizeof(int)));\n    g.membersCap = cap;\n\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_members);\n    g.h_members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_members, cap * sizeof(int)));\n    g.h_membersCap = cap;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank, const int nranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double t2max = squaredThreshold(threshold);\n\n    std::vector<double> hx(N), hy(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) { hx[i] = points[i].x; hy[i] = points[i].y; }\n\n    GpuContext gpu;\n    gpuInit(gpu, hx, hy, N);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> removed(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> dirty(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> card(N, 0);\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cache(N);\n\n    // Cyclic ownership of the seeds keeps the (spatially clustered) recompute\n    // sets evenly spread over the ranks.\n    std::vector<int> owned;\n    owned.reserve(N / nranks + 1);\n    for (int i = rank; i < N; i += nranks) {\n        owned.push_back(i);\n        dirty[i] = 1;\n    }\n\n    // Per-thread scratch for the host growth path\n    const int nthreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<std::vector<double>> scratch(nthreads);\n\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    std::vector<int> todo;\n    double _tgpu=0,_tcpu=0,_tmpi=0,_tinv=0; long _ngpu=0,_ncpu=0,_sgpu=0,_scpu=0;\n    bool devMaskValid = true;  // device copy of `clustered` up to date\n    int remaining = N;\n\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // ---- 1. (Re)compute the candidate clusters of the dirty owned seeds\n        todo.clear();\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < owned.size(); ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (dirty[s]) todo.push_back(s);\n        }\n\n        const int T = static_cast<int>(todo.size());\n        double _t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n        if (T >= QTC_GPU_MIN_SEEDS) {\n            if (!devMaskValid) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                      N * sizeof(unsigned char), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                devMaskValid = true;\n            }\n            for (int s0 = 0; s0 < T; s0 += gpu.maxBlocks) {\n                const int B = std::min(gpu.maxBlocks, T - s0);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.seeds, todo.data() + s0, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                qtGrowKernel<<<B, gpu.blockSize>>>(gpu.px, gpu.py, gpu.clustered, gpu.seeds,\n                                                   B, N, t2max, gpu.dwork, gpu.card);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.h_card, gpu.card, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n                size_t total = 0;\n                for (int b = 0; b < B; ++b) {\n                    gpu.h_offsets[b] = static_cast<int>(total);\n                    total += static_cast<size_t>(gpu.h_card[b]);\n                }\n                ensureMemberCapacity(gpu, total);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.offsets, gpu.h_offsets, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                qtCollectKernel<<<B, gpu.blockSize>>>(gpu.clustered, gpu.dwork, B, N,\n                                                      gpu.offsets, gpu.members);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.h_members, gpu.members, total * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n                #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n                for (int b = 0; b < B; ++b) {\n                    const int s = todo[s0 + b];\n                    const int c = gpu.h_card[b];\n                    card[s] = c;\n                    cache[s].assign(gpu.h_members + gpu.h_offsets[b],\n                                    gpu.h_members + gpu.h_offsets[b] + c);\n                    dirty[s] = 0;\n                }\n            }\n        } else if (T > 0) {\n            #pragma omp parallel\n            {\n                const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n                std::vector<double>& d = scratch[tid];\n                if (static_cast<int>(d.size()) != N) d.resize(N);\n                #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n                for (int j = 0; j < T; ++j) {\n                    const int s = todo[j];\n                    growClusterHost(s, hx.data(), hy.data(), clustered.data(), N, t2max,\n                                    d.data(), cache[s]);\n                    card[s] = static_cast<int>(cache[s].size());\n                    dirty[s] = 0;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (T >= QTC_GPU_MIN_SEEDS) { _tgpu += MPI_Wtime()-_t0; _ngpu++; _sgpu+=T; }\n        else { _tcpu += MPI_Wtime()-_t0; _ncpu++; _scpu+=T; }\n        _t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n        // ---- 2. Globally pick the seed with the largest cardinality\n        int local[2] = {-1, N};\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < owned.size(); ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (card[s] > local[0]) { local[0] = card[s]; local[1] = s; }\n        }\n        int best[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(local, best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_card = best[0];\n        const int best_seed = best[1];\n        if (best_seed >= N || best_card <= 0) break;\n\n        // ---- 3. Broadcast the winning cluster and commit it\n        std::vector<int> mem;\n        const int root = best_seed % nranks;\n        if (rank == root) {\n            mem = cache[best_seed];\n        } else {\n            mem.resize(best_card);\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(mem.data(), best_card, MPI_INT, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (int j = 0; j < best_card; ++j) {\n            clustered[mem[j]] = 1;\n            removed[mem[j]] = 1;\n        }\n        remaining -= best_card;\n        devMaskValid = false;\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            Cluster c;\n            c.seed_point = best_seed;\n            c.members = mem;\n            clusters.push_back(std::move(c));\n        }\n\n        _tmpi += MPI_Wtime()-_t0; _t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n        // ---- 4. Invalidate the cached candidate clusters that intersect the\n        //         cluster we just removed; everything else stays exact.\n        const int M = static_cast<int>(owned.size());\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (clustered[s]) { cache[s].clear(); cache[s].shrink_to_fit(); card[s] = -1; continue; }\n            if (dirty[s]) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& cm = cache[s];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < cm.size(); ++k) {\n                if (removed[cm[k]]) { dirty[s] = 1; card[s] = -1; break; }\n            }\n        }\n        for (int j = 0; j < best_card; ++j) removed[mem[j]] = 0;\n\n        owned.erase(std::remove_if(owned.begin(), owned.end(),\n                                   [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                    owned.end());\n        _tinv += MPI_Wtime()-_t0;\n    }\n    if (rank==0) fprintf(stderr,\"[prof] gpu %.3f (%ld it, %ld seeds) cpu %.3f (%ld it, %ld seeds) sel/bcast %.3f inval %.3f\\n\",_tgpu,_ngpu,_sgpu,_tcpu,_ncpu,_scpu,_tmpi,_tinv);\n\n    gpuFree(gpu);\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int C = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(C, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        const std::vector<int>& members = clusters[c].members;\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[members[i]], points[members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = c;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    // Bind one GPU per rank and share the cores of a node between the ranks\n    MPI_Comm local_comm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_comm);\n    int local_rank = 0, local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(local_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(local_comm, &local_size);\n\n    int devCount = 0;\n    if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount) != cudaSuccess || devCount == 0) {\n        if (rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"Error: no CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(local_rank % devCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));  // establish the context up front\n\n    if (omp_get_max_threads() > 1) {\n        const int cores = omp_get_num_procs();\n        int t = cores / local_size;\n        if (t < 1) t = 1;\n        omp_set_num_threads(t);\n    }\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, replicated on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, nranks);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_end = that is a member of the growing cluster or that was\n// already clustered globally.  actwork holds two index lists of N entries per\n// block that carry the candidates which can still join the cluster.  Because\n// the running maximum only ever grows, a candidate that once exceeded the\n// threshold can never become feasible again and is dropped from the list, which\n// shrinks the per-step scan from N to the local neighbourhood of the cluster.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QTC_MAX_BLOCK)\nvoid qtGrowKernel(const double* __restrict__ px,\n                  const double* __restrict__ py,\n                  const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                  const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                  const int numSeeds, const int N, const double t2max,\n                  double* __restrict__ dwork, int* __restrict__ actwork,\n                  int* __restrict__ card) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const int nwarps = nt >> 5;\n\n    double* __restrict__ d = dwork + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    int* cur_list = actwork + static_cast<size_t>(b) * 2 * N;\n    int* nxt_list = cur_list + N;\n\n    __shared__ double sv[QTC_MAX_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int si[QTC_MAX_BLOCK / 32];\n    __shared__ int s_next;\n    __shared__ int s_keep;\n\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n\n    // Initialise the distance row and the active candidate list\n    if (tid == 0) s_keep = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n    {\n        const int nround = ((N + nt - 1) / nt) * nt;\n        for (int j = tid; j < nround; j += nt) {\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (j < N) {\n                const bool cl = clustered[j] != 0;\n                d[j] = cl ? HUGE_VAL : 0.0;\n                keep = !cl && j != seed;\n            }\n            qtAppend(cur_list, &s_keep, keep, j, lane);\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    int nact = s_keep;\n    if (tid == 0) d[seed] = HUGE_VAL;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int cnt = 1;\n    int cur = seed;\n\n    while (cnt < N && nact > 0) {\n        if (tid == 0) s_keep = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const double mx = px[cur];\n        const double my = py[cur];\n\n        double bv = HUGE_VAL;\n        int bi = -1;\n        const int nround = ((nact + nt - 1) / nt) * nt;\n        for (int j = tid; j < nround; j += nt) {\n            bool keep = false;\n            int i = -1;\n            double v = HUGE_VAL;\n            if (j < nact) {\n                i = cur_list[j];\n                v = d[i];\n                const double dx = px[i] - mx;\n                const double dy = py[i] - my;\n                const double s = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n                if (s > v) { v = s; d[i] = v; }\n                keep = (v <= t2max);\n            }\n            qtAppend(nxt_list, &s_keep, keep, i, lane);\n            if (keep && qtBetter(v, i, bv, bi)) { bv = v; bi = i; }\n        }\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bv, off);\n            const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bi, off);\n            if (qtBetter(ov, oi, bv, bi)) { bv = ov; bi = oi; }\n        }\n        if (lane == 0) { sv[warp] = bv; si[warp] = bi; }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (warp == 0) {\n            bv = (lane < nwarps) ? sv[lane] : HUGE_VAL;\n            bi = (lane < nwarps) ? si[lane] : -1;\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bv, off);\n                const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bi, off);\n                if (qtBetter(ov, oi, bv, bi)) { bv = ov; bi = oi; }\n            }\n            if (lane == 0) s_next = bi;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int next = s_next;\n        nact = s_keep;\n        __syncthreads();  // everybody consumed s_next / s_keep\n\n        if (next < 0) break;\n        cur = next;\n        ++cnt;\n        if (tid == 0) d[cur] = HUGE_VAL;\n        int* tmp = cur_list; cur_list = nxt_list; nxt_list = tmp;\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) card[b] = cnt;\n}\n\n// Compact the member lists (points marked HUGE_VAL that are not globally\n// clustered) of every block into one contiguous output buffer.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(QTC_MAX_BLOCK)\nvoid qtCollectKernel(const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                     const double* __restrict__ dwork,\n                     const int numSeeds, const int N,\n                     const int* __restrict__ offsets,\n                     int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    __shared__ int pos;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) pos = offsets[b];\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const double* __restrict__ d = dwork + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n        if (d[i] == HUGE_VAL && !clustered[i]) {\n            out[atomicAdd(&pos, 1)] = i;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host side cluster growth - one OpenMP thread grows one seed.  Uses exactly\n// the same shrinking active-candidate list as the CUDA kernel.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct HostScratch {\n    std::vector<double> val;   // running squared max distance, per active entry\n    std::vector<int> idx;      // point index, per active entry\n    std::vector<double> ax, ay;\n};\n\nstatic void growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                            const double* __restrict__ px,\n                            const double* __restrict__ py,\n                            const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                            const int N, const double t2max,\n                            HostScratch& sc,\n                            std::vector<int>& members) {\n    sc.val.resize(N); sc.idx.resize(N); sc.ax.resize(N); sc.ay.resize(N);\n    double* __restrict__ val = sc.val.data();\n    int* __restrict__ idx = sc.idx.data();\n    double* __restrict__ ax = sc.ax.data();\n    double* __restrict__ ay = sc.ay.data();\n\n    int nact = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        if (!clustered[i] && i != seed) {\n            val[nact] = 0.0; idx[nact] = i; ax[nact] = px[i]; ay[nact] = py[i];\n            ++nact;\n        }\n    }\n\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n    int cur = seed;\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < N && nact > 0) {\n        const double mx = px[cur];\n        const double my = py[cur];\n        double bv = HUGE_VAL;\n        int bi = -1;\n        int keep = 0;\n        int bpos = -1;\n        for (int j = 0; j < nact; ++j) {\n            const double dx = ax[j] - mx;\n            const double dy = ay[j] - my;\n            const double s = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            double v = val[j];\n            if (s > v) v = s;\n            if (v <= t2max) {\n                const int i = idx[j];\n                val[keep] = v; idx[keep] = i; ax[keep] = ax[j]; ay[keep] = ay[j];\n                ++keep;\n                if (bi < 0 || v < bv || (v == bv && i < bi)) { bv = v; bi = i; }\n            }\n        }\n        nact = keep;\n        if (bi < 0) break;\n        members.push_back(bi);\n        cur = bi;\n        // The newly added member stays in the list but its value is forced\n        // above the threshold so that it is dropped in the next sweep.\n        for (int j = 0; j < nact; ++j) {\n            if (idx[j] == bi) { val[j] = HUGE_VAL; break; }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GPU resource management\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuContext {\n    double* px = nullptr;\n    double* py = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* clustered = nullptr;\n    int* seeds = nullptr;\n    double* dwork = nullptr;\n    int* actwork = nullptr;\n    int* card = nullptr;\n    int* offsets = nullptr;\n    int* members = nullptr;\n    size_t membersCap = 0;\n\n    int* h_card = nullptr;\n    int* h_offsets = nullptr;\n    int* h_members = nullptr;\n    size_t h_membersCap = 0;\n\n    int maxBlocks = 0;\n};\n\n// Few concurrent seeds -> wide blocks, so that a single cluster is grown by as\n// many threads as possible; many seeds -> narrow blocks for better occupancy.\nstatic int gpuBlockSize(const int numSeeds, const int N) {\n    int blk = 256;\n    if (numSeeds <= 256) blk = 1024;\n    else if (numSeeds <= 1024) blk = 512;\n    while (blk > 32 && blk >= 2 * N) blk >>= 1;\n    return blk;\n}\n\nstatic void gpuInit(GpuContext& g, const std::vector<double>& hx,\n                    const std::vector<double>& hy, const int N) {\n    size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n\n    // The growth kernel needs N doubles of scratch per concurrently grown seed.\n    size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(freeMem * 0.5);\n    size_t perBlock = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(double) + 2 * sizeof(int));\n    int maxBlocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(budget / perBlock, QTC_MAX_BLOCKS));\n    if (maxBlocks < 1) maxBlocks = 1;\n    if (maxBlocks > N) maxBlocks = N;\n    g.maxBlocks = maxBlocks;\n\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.px, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.py, N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.clustered, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.seeds, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.dwork, static_cast<size_t>(maxBlocks) * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.actwork, static_cast<size_t>(maxBlocks) * 2 * N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.card, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.offsets, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.px, hx.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.py, hy.data(), N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(g.clustered, 0, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_card, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_offsets, maxBlocks * sizeof(int)));\n}\n\nstatic void gpuFree(GpuContext& g) {\n    cudaFree(g.px);\n    cudaFree(g.py);\n    cudaFree(g.clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.dwork);\n    cudaFree(g.actwork);\n    cudaFree(g.card);\n    cudaFree(g.offsets);\n    cudaFree(g.members);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_card);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_offsets);\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_members);\n}\n\nstatic void ensureMemberCapacity(GpuContext& g, const size_t need) {\n    if (need <= g.membersCap) return;\n    size_t cap = std::max<size_t>(need, g.membersCap * 2);\n    cudaFree(g.members);\n    g.members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.members, cap * sizeof(int)));\n    g.membersCap = cap;\n\n    cudaFreeHost(g.h_members);\n    g.h_members = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&g.h_members, cap * sizeof(int)));\n    g.h_membersCap = cap;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank, const int nranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const double t2max = squaredThreshold(threshold);\n\n    std::vector<double> hx(N), hy(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) { hx[i] = points[i].x; hy[i] = points[i].y; }\n\n    GpuContext gpu;\n    gpuInit(gpu, hx, hy, N);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> removed(N, 0);\n    std::vector<unsigned char> dirty(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> card(N, 0);\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> cache(N);\n\n    // Cyclic ownership of the seeds keeps the (spatially clustered) recompute\n    // sets evenly spread over the ranks.\n    std::vector<int> owned;\n    owned.reserve(N / nranks + 1);\n    for (int i = rank; i < N; i += nranks) {\n        owned.push_back(i);\n        dirty[i] = 1;\n    }\n\n    // Per-thread scratch for the host growth path\n    const int nthreads = omp_get_max_threads();\n    std::vector<std::vector<double>> scratch(nthreads);\n\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    std::vector<int> todo;\n    double _tgpu=0,_tcpu=0,_tmpi=0,_tinv=0; long _ngpu=0,_ncpu=0,_sgpu=0,_scpu=0;\n    bool devMaskValid = true;  // device copy of `clustered` up to date\n    int remaining = N;\n\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        // ---- 1. (Re)compute the candidate clusters of the dirty owned seeds\n        todo.clear();\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < owned.size(); ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (dirty[s]) todo.push_back(s);\n        }\n\n        const int T = static_cast<int>(todo.size());\n        double _t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n        if (T >= QTC_GPU_MIN_SEEDS) {\n            if (!devMaskValid) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                      N * sizeof(unsigned char), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                devMaskValid = true;\n            }\n            for (int s0 = 0; s0 < T; s0 += gpu.maxBlocks) {\n                const int B = std::min(gpu.maxBlocks, T - s0);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.seeds, todo.data() + s0, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                const int blk = gpuBlockSize(B, N);\n                qtGrowKernel<<<B, blk>>>(gpu.px, gpu.py, gpu.clustered, gpu.seeds,\n                                         B, N, t2max, gpu.dwork, gpu.actwork, gpu.card);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.h_card, gpu.card, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n                size_t total = 0;\n                for (int b = 0; b < B; ++b) {\n                    gpu.h_offsets[b] = static_cast<int>(total);\n                    total += static_cast<size_t>(gpu.h_card[b]);\n                }\n                ensureMemberCapacity(gpu, total);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.offsets, gpu.h_offsets, B * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                qtCollectKernel<<<B, blk>>>(gpu.clustered, gpu.dwork, B, N,\n                                            gpu.offsets, gpu.members);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(gpu.h_members, gpu.members, total * sizeof(int),\n                                      cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n                #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n                for (int b = 0; b < B; ++b) {\n                    const int s = todo[s0 + b];\n                    const int c = gpu.h_card[b];\n                    card[s] = c;\n                    cache[s].assign(gpu.h_members + gpu.h_offsets[b],\n                                    gpu.h_members + gpu.h_offsets[b] + c);\n                    dirty[s] = 0;\n                }\n            }\n        } else if (T > 0) {\n            #pragma omp parallel\n            {\n                const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n                std::vector<double>& d = scratch[tid];\n                if (static_cast<int>(d.size()) != N) d.resize(N);\n                #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n                for (int j = 0; j < T; ++j) {\n                    const int s = todo[j];\n                    growClusterHost(s, hx.data(), hy.data(), clustered.data(), N, t2max,\n                                    d.data(), cache[s]);\n                    card[s] = static_cast<int>(cache[s].size());\n                    dirty[s] = 0;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (T >= QTC_GPU_MIN_SEEDS) { _tgpu += MPI_Wtime()-_t0; _ngpu++; _sgpu+=T; }\n        else { _tcpu += MPI_Wtime()-_t0; _ncpu++; _scpu+=T; }\n        _t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n        // ---- 2. Globally pick the seed with the largest cardinality\n        int local[2] = {-1, N};\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < owned.size(); ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (card[s] > local[0]) { local[0] = card[s]; local[1] = s; }\n        }\n        int best[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(local, best, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_card = best[0];\n        const int best_seed = best[1];\n        if (best_seed >= N || best_card <= 0) break;\n\n        // ---- 3. Broadcast the winning cluster and commit it\n        std::vector<int> mem;\n        const int root = best_seed % nranks;\n        if (rank == root) {\n            mem = cache[best_seed];\n        } else {\n            mem.resize(best_card);\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(mem.data(), best_card, MPI_INT, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        for (int j = 0; j < best_card; ++j) {\n            clustered[mem[j]] = 1;\n            removed[mem[j]] = 1;\n        }\n        remaining -= best_card;\n        devMaskValid = false;\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            Cluster c;\n            c.seed_point = best_seed;\n            c.members = mem;\n            clusters.push_back(std::move(c));\n        }\n\n        _tmpi += MPI_Wtime()-_t0; _t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n        // ---- 4. Invalidate the cached candidate clusters that intersect the\n        //         cluster we just removed; everything else stays exact.\n        const int M = static_cast<int>(owned.size());\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {\n            const int s = owned[j];\n            if (clustered[s]) { cache[s].clear(); cache[s].shrink_to_fit(); card[s] = -1; continue; }\n            if (dirty[s]) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& cm = cache[s];\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < cm.size(); ++k) {\n                if (removed[cm[k]]) { dirty[s] = 1; card[s] = -1; break; }\n            }\n        }\n        for (int j = 0; j < best_card; ++j) removed[mem[j]] = 0;\n\n        owned.erase(std::remove_if(owned.begin(), owned.end(),\n                                   [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                    owned.end());\n        _tinv += MPI_Wtime()-_t0;\n    }\n    if (rank==0) fprintf(stderr,\"[prof] gpu %.3f (%ld it, %ld seeds) cpu %.3f (%ld it, %ld seeds) sel/bcast %.3f inval %.3f\\n\",_tgpu,_ngpu,_sgpu,_tcpu,_ncpu,_scpu,_tmpi,_tinv);\n\n    gpuFree(gpu);\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int C = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(C, 0.0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        const std::vector<int>& members = clusters[c].members;\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[members[i]], points[members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (int c = 0; c < C; ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = c;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n\n    // Bind one GPU per rank and share the cores of a node between the ranks\n    MPI_Comm local_comm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_comm);\n    int local_rank = 0, local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(local_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(local_comm, &local_size);\n\n    int devCount = 0;\n    if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount) != cudaSuccess || devCount == 0) {\n        if (rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"Error: no CUDA device available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(local_rank % devCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));  // establish the context up front\n\n    if (omp_get_max_threads() > 1) {\n        const int cores = omp_get_num_procs();\n        int t = cores / local_size;\n        if (t < 1) t = 1;\n        omp_set_num_threads(t);\n    }\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance
